Order 
07.05.2025 Order No. (Through hybrid mode)
03.

1. This matter was listed on 23.04.2025 and has been adjourned to today to enable Mr. Mohapatra,
learned counsel for the petitioner to make further research.

2. Mr. Mohapatra, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that since preliminary charge sheet dated 14.11.2024 had been submitted against him under Section 498A, 313, 34 of the IPC keeping investigation open for taking further action.

He submits that unless the further proceedings in the case are stayed, trial will commence in the case and if thereafter, the police submit final charge sheet, stating that no case is made out against the petitioner, the petitioner will not be able to avail of this benefit.
Referring to Section 193(8) of the BNSS, he submits that the said provision does not permit further investigation.

3. Mr. S. J. Mohanty, learned Addl. Standing Counsel submits that one of the grounds taken in the CRLMC for quashing the proceeding in C.T. case No. 914 of 2024 corresponding to S.T. Case No. 58 of 2024 is that the offence under Section 498A, 313 of the IPC is not made out against the petitioner as he has neither married her nor aborted the pregnancy of the victim and a false case has been filed against him as he was in a relationship with her consent and she is a major but she has foisted a false case against the petitioner.
He submits on the basis of the investigation, the police has submitted charge sheet against the petitioner under Section 498A, 313 of the IPC.

His further submission is that although it is unlikely but in case any material is found to be in favour of the petitioner, the same can be urged by the petitioner at the time of the trial but merely because preliminary charge sheet has been filed in this case keeping investigation open, the proceedings against the petitioner cannot be quashed on that ground.
4. Hearing is concluded.
